feeds.title: Pastreez
feeds.description: I'm Anthony, co-founder of pastreez. I'm crazy about macarons for a very long time. But my soulmate is allergic to dairy products. Follow this blog for gluten-free & organic macarons.

feeds.title: Indulge With Mimi
feeds.description: Indulge With Mimi is a blog all about baking macarons. Explains the proper macaronage techniques, how to use your oven, avoid hollow macarons and more.

feeds.title: Boutique Point G
feeds.description: Located in Montreal, Point G is a specialist in gourmet products recognized for the quality of its macarons on the North American market.

feeds.title: caramel factory » Macaron
feeds.description: Caramel Factory is a baking school and patisserie located at Shah Alam, Selangor. Caramel Factory has all sorts of recipes, pictures and videos of my adventures in baking! I've always liked baking, mostly Japanese-style pastries and breads.

feeds.title: The French Macaron Critic
feeds.description: The French Macaron Critic is chronicling her journey to find and taste magnificent French macarons, help others to find their perfect one and support local businesses.

feeds.title: ANGEL BAKE Café
feeds.description: Baking traditional Macarons with Angel Bake products is amazingly simple. Follow this blog for French Macaron Recipes with Buttercram Filling.

feeds.title: Margot & Montanez
feeds.description: Discover authentic South American Alfajores biscuits and sweet delicatessen created with great passion, made-to-order, and with high-quality ingredients to ensure the freshest taste. Gluten-free, vegan, and vegetarian produce also available.

feeds.title: Chantal Guillon
feeds.description: Chantal Guillon is above all a novel interpretation of the macaron, conceived as a unique, original, surprising creation. The selection includes both classic flavors and limited-edition macarons to be discovered according to the seasons and for special events. All created locally in San Francisco by a dedicated French and American team.
